external_identity_recheck_method: Each DOI and bibliographic identity was checked against a publisher page, DOI resolver result, or recognized scholarly index; the nearby manuscript sentence was then checked for direct support and project relevance.
verification_scope: All 73 records were checked one by one for bibliographic identity, unique scholarly identifier, strongly related project relevance, and the precision of the nearby single-paper claim. Verification used DOI resolution plus publisher or recognized scholarly-index metadata and available abstracts or contribution summaries; it is not a claim of a new full-text systematic review of every paper.
